description: ASTRAVIA_77 is a solo space innovation initiative driven by curiosity, creativity, and a passion for exploring the unknown. Founded and developed by one passionate engineering enthusiast, the team aims to turn ambitious ideas into meaningful technological solutions. Through MARS-NAV, we are working towards safer and smarter Martian exploration using interactive terrain mapping and intelligent rover route planning. One mind, one mission, limitless possibilities.
summary:
MARS-NAV is an interactive Martian exploration and rover navigation system developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Focused on Jezero Crater, the project provides an integrated platform for exploring Mars through interactive surface maps, 3D terrain visualization, elevation analysis, and terrain-aware rover route planning.

Using Mars terrain datasets, including MOLA, HRSC, and NASA CTX imagery, MARS-NAV helps users examine surface features, understand elevation variations, and explore potential rover pathways. Its route-planning system considers terrain conditions and slope constraints to identify safer exploration routes. The platform also includes a survival planner and scientific data section to support mission-oriented exploration.

MARS-NAV aims to make planetary exploration more accessible by combining geospatial visualization, terrain intelligence, and interactive mission-planning tools in one platform.
details:
MARS-NAV is an interactive Martian exploration and rover navigation platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The project focuses on Jezero Crater, Mars, and aims to make planetary exploration more accessible through an integrated mission-control interface.

The application includes an interactive Mars surface map, 3D Jezero terrain visualization, elevation and terrain analysis, terrain-aware rover route planning, a survival planner, and scientific data exploration.

Built using Python, Streamlit, NumPy, Pandas, Plotly, Folium, Streamlit-Folium, and Rasterio, MARS-NAV combines geospatial data processing and interactive visualization to support exploration and safer rover route planning.

Our goal is to demonstrate how terrain intelligence and interactive mapping can support future planetary exploration missions.
